title: Core v0.6 continuation and foundation gate
summary: Core v0.6-pre2 is a new immutable version line rebasing the accepted v0.5 architecture onto Alchemy Objects v0.8 and ooRexx Crypto v0.8.3. The 2026-09-02 API roll-up now byte-confirms those exact two foundation archive hashes, closing pre2's outer-byte gate; adoption, full closure and resident end-to-end qualification remain required before RC1.
invariants: Target Alchemy Objects v0.8 SHA-256 is 7683ed56ea99097226ea2f13f73305fb49919ba2ec822df2253ccfff59c6c073.
Target ooRexx Crypto v0.8.3 SHA-256 is 5ebcab81493287499719f98920cb190d37afc79992cb34c7772d5392f63b9b49.
The 2026-09-02 roll-up contains exact nested archives with those hashes.
The v0.6-pre2 artifact remains NOT RC / NOT ACCEPTED even though the outer-byte foundation check is now satisfied.
Objects v0.8 documents oorexx_crypto_v0.1 as its own external dependency; therefore Core v0.6's v0.8.3 companion choice must be proven by STANDARD adoption and executable closure qualification.
Required remaining gate: exact Objects v0.8 adoption, full 13-package v0.6 suites on r13196, dirty/stale-checkout + repository-lease + manifest-identity + resident-service E2E, then RC1.
